name: Bakunyuu Okami ~Iyasare Hitozuma Haramase no Yu~
original_name: 爆乳女将 ～癒され人妻孕ませの湯～
source:
Hoping to remedy physical and mental exhaustion from work, the protagonist makes a visit to a hot-spring hotel at a friend’s recommendation. The innkeeper, Konari Tokie, has been working there since the inn first opened, although she has since drifted away from her entertainment-providing services. Our totally out-of-spirit protagonist has decided to book an extended stay in this elegant inn lifestyle. The service gradually escalates, and together with the hotel waitress Harutori Isuka and guest Sukii Natsumi, their relationships rapidly deepen as the naughtiness swells. As their intimacy increases, so does the prospect of having a child, leading to understandable hesitation. The innkeeper is a married woman, he shouldn’t be seeing this side of her...right?
